AGENDA
OF A REGULAR MEETING
OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA 90274
Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.
NEXT RESOLUTION NO. R18-49
NEXT ORDINANCE NO. 18-735

CONSENT AGENDA (ITEMS 1 - 7)
All items under this heading are considered to be routine and will be enacted by one motion, unless a Councilmember or staff requests that an item be removed for separate discussion. Any item removed from the Consent Agenda will be considered immediately following the motion to approve the Consent Agenda.
PUBLIC COMMENTS FOR ITEMS ON CONSENT AGENDA
Speakers shall be provided up to 3 minutes to speak regarding all topics on the Consent Agenda.
1.
Draft City Council Action Minutes
Recommendation: Review and Approve.
a.
July 24, 2018; Regular Meeting
b.
October 9, 2018; Regular Meeting
Minutes
2.
Demands of October 23, 2018
Recommendation: Approve payment of Motions #1 and #2.
a.
Motion #1 – Payroll Warrant of October 19, 2018
b.
Motion #2 – Warrant Register of October 23, 2018
Demands
3.
Special Event Application for the Lexus LaceUp Running Series Palos Verdes Marathon Scheduled for Saturday, November 17, 2018
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve the request and fees charged to allow the Lexus LaceUp Running Series Palos Verdes to travel through Palos Verdes Estates on Saturday, November 17, 2018 from 7:00 a.m. to 11:00 a.m.
Staff Report
4.
Special Event Application of the River Church of the South Bay and Watts & Associates from Remax Palos Verdes to Hold a Christmas Sing-A-Long Concert in the Park at Lunada Bay Park on December 16, 2018
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve the request and fees charged to allow the River Church of the South Bay and Watts & Associates from Remax Palos Verdes to hold a Christmas Sing-a-Long Concert in the Park at Lunada Bay Park on Sunday, December 16, 2018, from 6:30 p.m. to 8:00 p.m.
Staff Report
5.
Acceptance of Donations
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council accept the gifts as presented.
Staff Report
6.
Approval of Resolution R18-48 Adjusting the FY 18/19 Budget to Appropriate Additional Funds for Approval of the Finance Plus Accounting Software 5.2 Cloud Upgrade
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve an appropriation of $10,000 for the 5.2 cloud host upgrade of the Finance Plus accounting system.
Staff Report
7.
Approval of Resolutions R18-44, R18-45, R18-46 and R18-47 Calling for the General Municipal Election to be Held on March 5, 2019 for the Purpose of Electing Three (3) Members of the City Council, Adopting Regulations Pertaining to Candidate Statements, Requesting that Los Angeles County Provide Election Services, and Adjusting the FY 2018/19 Budget to Appropriate Additional Funds for Approval of Election Services
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution R18-44 calling for the election of three City officers for a term of 3 years and 8 months, Resolution R18-45 adopting regulations for candidates for elective office pertaining to candidate statements including foreign language translations and filing fees, Resolution R18-46 requesting the Board of Supervisors of the County of Los Angeles to direct the Registrar-Recorder/County Clerk to administer, manage and oversee the City of Palos Verdes Estates' General Municipal Election to be held on Tuesday, March 5, 2019, and Resolution R18-47 adjusting the FY 2018/19 budget to appropriate additional funds for approval of election services from Los Angeles County and Gladwell Governmental Services, and an appropriation of funds thereof.
Staff Report
COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC
This portion of the agenda is reserved for comments from the public on items which are NOT on the agenda. Due to state law, no action can be taken by the Council this evening on matters presented under this section. If the Council determines action is warranted, the item may be referred to staff or placed on a future Council agenda.
NEW BUSINESS
10.
Consideration of Unclaimed Check Policy
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve and adopt the proposed Unclaimed Check Policy.
Staff Report
11.
Consideration of Capital Asset Policy
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve and adopt the proposed Capital Asset Policy.
Staff Report
12.
Consideration of Agenda Topics for Joint Meeting of the City Council and Parklands Committee on October 30, 2018
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council review the proposed agenda items for its meeting with the Parklands Committee and determine the topics to discuss.
Staff Report
PUBLIC HEARINGS/ORDINANCE(S)
All persons addressing the City Council during public hearings shall be limited to three (3) minutes for comment, except for an Appellant/Applicant, which shall be provided five (5) minutes for presentation and rebuttal.
8.
Request to Appeal Planning Commission Approval NC-1624/G-1617/M-1258-18; Neighborhood Compatibility, Grading Permit, and Miscellaneous Applications for Additions and Remodeling to the Single-Family Residence and Walls Exceeding the Allowable Height Located at 421 Via Media. Lots 12 & 13, Block 1511, Tract 6886. (Resolution No. Pcr-2018-1070)
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council open the public hearing, receive public input, close the public hearing, and make a decision on the application.
Staff Report

Request to Appeal Planning Commission Approval of NC-1626-18; Neighborhood Compatibility Application for a Remodel and Addition to an Existing Single-Family Residence Located at 1509 Espinosa Circle. Lot 20, Block 1376, Tract 6889.
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council open the public hearing, receive public input, close the public hearing, and make a decision on the application.
Staff Report

ADJOURNMENT TO TUESDAY, OCTOBER 30, 2018, AT 6:00 P.M. AT THE MALAGA COVE LIBRARY GALLERY ROOM FOR THE PURPOSE OF A JOINT MEETING WITH THE PARKLANDS COMMITTEE.
